decision: Scaling to20,000,000 tracking samples and200,000 Gaussian trajectories over200 rounds is justified for the stated numerical-components checkpoint. This is not approval to claim full Figure3 reproduction.

commands.result: exit0;100,000 tracking samples;1,000 trajectories over10 rounds; control and conditional-mean estimator both finite

smoke_result.scope: Journal D1/D2 tracking probability; local-Gaussian Bayesian variance Eqs13/15.

independent_numerics.tracking_method: Reverse integration order: integrate Gaussian readout residual e within each rounding cell, then analytic Gaussian u tails outside that cell. Return after4-cell jumps is omitted with negligible bound at sigma=.02236.

journal_equations_visually_checked.tracking_statement: Journal specifies approximately1e-5 at Delta=.2182 and sigma0_squared=.0005; independently reduced integral1.8026651e-5 is consistent at order-of-magnitude precision.

scientific_checks: D1 transforms to independent u~N(0,sigma0_squared),e~N(0,Delta_squared), and integer comb index n. Integer shifts preserve the equality-of-mod4-rounded-residues event, so normalized envelope weights cancel.

For |u|<=12sigma0, the implementation sums disjoint boundary crossings and symmetry handles both signs. Omitted u mass is negligible; no appreciable multiple-boundary or modulo4-return term at these parameters.
Literal C10 entrywise construction equals B-transpose-B precision exactly; matrix conditional mean and recursive estimator agree within8.7e-19.
Gaussian posterior variance at200 rounds equals independent stationary Riccati solution; Eq15/C15 is correctly identified as a truncated expansion.
No-estimator control is the zero conditional mean of the prior shift; intervention uses only measurements through the current round.
Smoke exact posterior variance lies in the estimated chi-square95 interval.

resource_assessment.tracking_storage: Retains chunk counts and failure pairs; does not retain20M full pairs. Working arrays are tens of MB.
resource_assessment.variance_storage: O(200000) active vectors plus200 summary rows and terminal samples;200x200 precision matrix.
resource_assessment.seed_scope: Confirmation seeds and sample counts fixed in protocol; validator ran no production Monte Carlo.

limitations: Smoke saw0 tracking failures; this is statistically plausible but weak evidence and must not be advertised as a rare-event reproduction.
20M samples should yield about361 tracking failures, allowing roughly10% relative95 uncertainty.
This covers single-round tracking and the local-Gaussian q-quadrature posterior only.
No finite-energy channel, truncation fidelity, modular-subsystem scoring, memoryless comparison or Figure3 has been reproduced.
A production point outside its preregistered interval must be reported/audited, not corrected by changing noise parameters.
